target: local gcp-dev candidate, not deployed production

cases.query: How many ANEMONE samples and assays are available?
cases.expected_behavior: Give 3,498 source occurrences and assays; physical sample identity remains unresolved.

cases.query: How many physical samples are included in ANEMONE?
cases.expected_behavior: Do not call 3,498 distinct physical samples; explicitly state unresolved identity.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE negative controls are there?
cases.expected_behavior: 343 negative-control occurrences, explicitly scoped.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE samples have unknown control status?
cases.expected_behavior: 3,155 unknown-control-status occurrences; distinguish them from environmental samples.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE environmental samples are available?
cases.expected_behavior: Zero explicitly classified environmental occurrences; explain this is classification, not biological absence.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE reads are available per method?
cases.expected_behavior: 157,426,611 reads and 174,819 assignments in each method, never sum shared reads.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE QCauto+3-NN assignment rows are available?
cases.expected_behavior: 174,819 rows in the selected method.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE community tables are empty?
cases.expected_behavior: 83 valid empty source tables per method; distinguish empty from missing.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE internal standard reads are available?
cases.expected_behavior: 442,404,272 standard reads across 13,932 rows; do not treat standards as biological detections or proof of calibration.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE concentrations are missing or unavailable?
cases.expected_behavior: Report missing and source-column-absent counts separately, per method.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE samples are available by project?
cases.expected_behavior: Complete 10-project breakdown summing to 3,498 source occurrences.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE nontarget reads are available?
cases.expected_behavior: Cited zero matching records/available tables in this imported catalogue, not ecological absence.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE samples of Ablabys taenianotus are available?
cases.expected_behavior: One occurrence and one QCauto assignment, with exact scoped evidence.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE samples are in this date range?
cases.expected_behavior: Cited zero for explicit 2099 interval; no historical data substitution.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE samples are in the selected project?
cases.expected_behavior: Cited zero for explicit nonexistent project.

cases.query: Can you summarize the ANEMONE database?
cases.expected_behavior: Recognize an ordinary paraphrase of an unfiltered catalogue summary.

cases.query: Please tell me how many ANEMONE samples we currently have.
cases.expected_behavior: Same whole-catalogue count with valid citations.

cases.query: What is the ANEMONE sample count?
cases.expected_behavior: Same whole-catalogue count, independent of wording.

cases.query: ANEMONEにはいくつのサンプルがありますか？
cases.expected_behavior: Answer the Japanese count request accurately, or explicitly state the language limitation; do not falsely ask for missing geographic scope.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE samples were collected in Japan in 2020?
cases.expected_behavior: Ask for explicit geography/date filters; do not give unfiltered totals.

cases.query: How many species are detected in ANEMONE?
cases.expected_behavior: State that exact richness is not implemented in this aggregate; no top-k estimate.

cases.query: How many ANEMONE negative and positive controls are there?
cases.expected_behavior: Ideally give separate counts; current bounded scope may request clarification. Record as capability limitation if so.

cases.query: Does a higher ANEMONE read count mean there are more fish?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain that read counts are not organism abundance; this is interpretation, not a count request.

cases.query: Can I add the reads from QCauto and QCauto+3-NN to estimate fish abundance in ANEMONE?
cases.expected_behavior: Reject double counting and organism abundance inference with cited method evidence.

cases.query: Do ANEMONE negative controls prove the environmental samples are contamination-free?
cases.expected_behavior: Reject proof of absence of contamination; cite provider controls and unknown classifications.

cases.query: Do ANEMONE copies per mL establish fish abundance without checking internal standards and protocols?
cases.expected_behavior: Distinguish concentration from abundance; disclose calibration/protocol limits.

cases.query: What evidence supports the ANEMONE detection of Ablabys taenianotus?
cases.expected_behavior: Cite the filtered assay/detection; distinguish sequence assignment from confirmed occurrence.

cases.query: Does missing ANEMONE concentration data mean the concentration is zero?
cases.expected_behavior: Explicitly reject missing=zero with cited concentration-status evidence.

cases.query: Compare QCauto and QCauto+3-NN in ANEMONE. Is agreement independent validation?
cases.expected_behavior: Separate alternate interpretations of shared sequence evidence; agreement is not independent validation.

cases.query: Has ANEMONE data from last week arrived?
cases.expected_behavior: Distinguish collection date from acquisition/publication; no invented provider freshness.
